|           |-- Canonicalize binding root; require matching kind and existing directory

|       |       |-- Timeout, process/RPC failure or 5-minute idle -> dispose
|       |       |-- Later lookup replaces a dead session

`-- Registered Git identity and context [infrastructure/core/persistence/repositoryRegistry.ts]
    |-- GitRepositoryRegistry persists repositories in project.json
    |   |-- Discover identity -> repo- + first 24 hex characters of SHA-256(identity)
    |   |-- Initialize only when repositories is absent
    |   |   `-- Discover checkout + Git source roots; merge roots for the same identity
    |   |       `-- Undiscoverable/non-Git roots are not assigned a repository
    |   `-- Register -> merge checkout roots and name; serialize atomic writes per file
    |-- Resolve checkout for a registered repository
    |   |-- Try saved roots, then current checkout; require matching Git identity
    |   `-- Unknown repository ID or no usable checkout -> error
    `-- ChangeSession context and captured hunks
        |-- Explicit repositoryId, or exactly one registered repository, is required
        |-- Resolve head (default HEAD), commits and optional comparisonBase to commit SHAs
        |   `-- Cache repeated ref resolution; deduplicate commits; validate context
